design_philosophy.concept: Arcade Flavor Quest — Subway Surfers energy meets contemporary Indian dining hospitality
design_philosophy.blend: Playful arcade progression (XP counter, coin bursts, snappy card swipes, scratch card unlock) grounded in warm artisanal dining aesthetics (saffron, cardamom, terracotta, rich cream background).
design_philosophy.target_device: Mobile-first PWA (max 480px centered on desktop viewport)
design_philosophy.context: QR table scan at Indian restaurants — zero friction, 0 logins, high dopamine, transparent reward

colors.palette_strategy: CSS Variable driven dynamic multi-tenant engine supporting any restaurant accent colour while defaulting to Royal Saffron on Warm Kulhad Cream

typography.headline_font: Space Grotesk Variable, Sora Variable, sans-serif
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans Variable, Inter, sans-serif

hierarchy_rules.level_header: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-stone-900 leading-snug

entry_surfaces./: gamified mobile arcade shell — sticky XP header + level progress ribbon top, swipeable quest card center, sticky action dock bottom
entry_surfaces./review: gamified multi-stage quest — live coin counter top, interactive dish/vibe tiles center, haptic submit bottom
entry_surfaces./reward: golden scratch arena — reward chest teaser top, canvas scratch card center, reveal confetti blast + claim code bottom

visual_enhancers.floating_xp_pills: Animated '+10 XP' or '+50 PTS' floating badges with spring bounce when guest interacts (e.g., taps a star, selects a dish tag)
visual_enhancers.progress_track: Subway-surfers style tiered milestone rail (Level 1: Taste Score -> Level 2: Star Dishes -> Level 3: Vibe & Chef Note -> Level 4: Magic Draft -> Level 5: Mystery Reward)
visual_enhancers.haptic_tactile_feedback: Active button depression (scale: 0.96) with 2px solid bottom-border offset giving an arcade game cartridge tactile feel
visual_enhancers.cooking_loader_animation: Wok stir-fry & spice bubbling particle animation while AI generates the single review draft
visual_enhancers.canvas_scratch_layer: HTML5 Canvas scratch-off surface with metallic foil texture, sparkle particles, 65% reveal threshold auto-wipe, and crisp confetti explosion
visual_enhancers.offline_status_ribbon: Pill banner at top with cloud-off icon: 'Offline mode active — your reward & review save locally!'

header_hud.title: Arcade HUD Bar
elements: Restaurant Avatar + Name + Table No badge
XP/Coin Balance Badge with spinning coin icon (e.g., '120 XP')
Live 4-segment animated progress rail (Subway Surfers sprint bar with glowing active pip)

level_1_rating.title: Level 1: Rate the Feast
level_1_rating.subheading_copy: Tap your score to kick off your reward quest (+20 XP)
level_1_rating.component: Big juicy interactive stars or expressive emoji cards (1-5) with scale bounce on hover/tap

branching_logic.4_to_5_stars: Unlocks Level 2 (Dishes) -> Happy path -> AI Google Review Draft
branching_logic.1_to_3_stars: Directs to Private Guest Care portal (+30 XP) -> Direct feedback to General Manager -> Instant 'We are sorry' Scratch Reward

level_2_dishes.title: Level 2: What Hit the Spot?
level_2_dishes.heading_copy: Pick the champions of your table!
level_2_dishes.subheading_copy: Select up to 4 dishes (+10 XP each)
level_2_dishes.component: 2-column grid of rich dish cards with food icons, dish thumbnail, spice level badge, and checkmark toggle states with pop animations

level_3_vibes_notes.title: Level 3: Vibe & Chef Shout-out
level_3_vibes_notes.subheading_copy: Tap vibe chips + add an optional note for the kitchen (+20 XP)
level_3_vibes_notes.component: Multi-select chip cloud (e.g. '⚡ Fast Service', '🎵 Great Music', '🔥 Royal Hospitality', '👨‍🍳 Chef Special') + expandable micro-textarea with placeholder 'e.g. The Dum Biryani gravy was unmatched!'

level_3_5_cooking_loader.title: Full Screen AI Cooking State
level_3_5_cooking_loader.heading_copy: Chef AI is cooking your review draft...
level_3_5_cooking_loader.subheading_copy: Blending your selected dishes, spices, and vibes into a 5-star masterpiece
level_3_5_cooking_loader.animation: Animated Tandoor / Kadai icon with floating aroma particles and progress tick-list: 'Adding Biryani love...', 'Seasoning compliments...', 'Polishing Google review...'

level_4_review_draft.title: Level 4: Review Ready for Google
level_4_review_draft.subheading_copy: 1-click copy & share on Google to instantly unlock your scratch reward (+50 XP)
card_features: Single clean editable text card with live character count
'🎲 Remix Draft' button to cycle tone (Foodie, Concise, Royal Feast)
'📋 Copy & Open Google Review' primary glowing action button

level_5_reward_scratch.title: Level 5: Grab Your Table Reward
level_5_reward_scratch.subheading_copy: Enter your mobile number to reveal your instant gift
flow: Step A: Enter Guest Name & 10-digit Phone Number
Step B: Fast 6-digit SMS verification code (demo mode shows instant auto-fill code pill 'Tap to Fill: 789456')
Step C: HTML5 Canvas Scratch-Off Card (Scratch with finger/cursor to wipe metallic layer)
Step D: Reveal celebration with confetti blast, voucher code (e.g. 'CHEF-GIFT-15'), '15% Off Your Next Dine-in', and 'Save to WhatsApp / Show to Server' action
level_5_reward_scratch.unhappy_path_framing: We value your honest feedback deeply. Please enjoy this complimentary dessert/discount on your next visit as our warm apology.

ai_generation_failed.title: Oops! The AI Kitchen got a bit smoky
ai_generation_failed.body: No worries — we have saved your dish picks. You can write your own words or try cooking again.

offline_screen.title: You are currently offline
offline_screen.body: Don't fret! Your review draft and table reward code are safely cached on this phone.

restaurant_not_found.title: Table QR Expired or Table Not Found
restaurant_not_found.body: Please ask your server for a fresh QR code or select your restaurant branch.

keyframes.coin_spin: @keyframes spinCoin { 0% { transform: rotateY(0deg) scale(1); } 50% { transform: rotateY(180deg) scale(1.15); } 100% { transform: rotateY(360deg) scale(1); } }
keyframes.steam_float: @keyframes steamFloat { 0% { transform: translateY(0px) opacity(0.8); } 100% { transform: translateY(-24px) opacity(0); } }

accessibility.aria_roles: All custom scratch canvases must have aria-label='Interactive scratch-off reward card' with keyboard fallback 'Reveal Reward Now' button.
accessibility.color_contrast: All text tokens strictly comply with minimum 4.5:1 ratio over cream (#FDFBF7) and card (#FFFFFF) surfaces.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' by substituting complex canvas sparkles with instant fade reveals and disabling parallax.
accessibility.touch_targets: All tappable chips, stars, and buttons maintain minimum 48px x 48px touch bounding box.

image_urls.description: Aromatic Hyderabadi Dum Biryani with saffron rice & fresh herbs
Rich Indian copper handi curry table feast with naan and appetizers
Authentic flavored rice plate with South Indian curry leaves

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace boring multi-step forms with an arcade-style card stage navigation driven by motion/react AnimatePresence with directional x-slide.
2. Implement the floating coin / XP counter in the header that pops with '+10 XP' every time the guest taps an option.
3. Change the AI generation output from 3 drafts to 1 prominent editable draft with a '🎲 Remix Tone' button (Foodie -> Royal Feast -> Quick & Crisp).
4. Place the Phone + SMS verification strictly at Level 5 as the 'Unlock Table Reward' step, including demo-mode 1-tap OTP fill.

5. Build the HTML5 canvas scratch card with silver/gold glitter gradient overlay and touch-move eraser (globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'). Once 60-70% is cleared, automatically trigger full reveal with react-confetti or canvas-confetti blast.
6. Handle the unhappy path (1-3 stars): pivot smoothly into 'Private Chef Note' with empathetic tone, then immediately transition to Level 5 with 'A Token of Our Apology' scratch reward.
7. Implement playful animated full-screen cooking loader and fallback retry states for offline or AI generation errors.
